# Provider

fun interface [Provider](index.html) : [Instruction](../index.html)

A function that produces the instruction [Content](../../../com.google.adk.kt.types/-content/index.html) at turn time, given a [ReadonlyContext](../../-readonly-context/index.html).

Returning `null` indicates "no instruction this turn".
